Weekend ke liye ek simple aur tasty recipe: Paneer Butter Masala.

Samagri: 200g paneer, 3 tamatar, 1 pyaaz, 2 tbsp kaju, 1 tbsp butter, adrak-lehsun paste, lal mirch, garam masala, namak, thodi cream.

Vidhi:
1. Butter mein pyaaz, tamatar, kaju aur adrak-lehsun bhoon lo.
2. Thanda karke smooth paste bana lo.
3. Pan mein butter garam karo, paste daalo, masale aur namak mila kar 5 minute pakao.
4. Paneer ke cubes aur cream daalo, 3-4 minute simmer karo.

Garma garam naan ya jeera rice ke saath serve karo. Maza aayega!

Zaroor! Ye lijiye draft:

"Pranam Dada ji,
Aap kaise hain? Main aapko batana chahta tha ki main is festival pe ghar aa raha hoon. Aapse milne aur saath mein tyohaar manane ka bahut mann hai. Aap apna dhyan rakhiye, mera intezaar kijiyega. Jald hi milte hain.
Aapka pota"

Agar aap chahein to main ise thoda aur casual ya aur formal bana sakta hoon, ya travel date aur time bhi jod sakta hoon.

Gradient descent ek tarika hai jisse machine learning model apni galtiyan kam karta hai.

Sochiye aap pahaad par aankhein band karke khade hain aur sabse neeche vaali ghaati tak pahunchna hai. Aap pair se check karte ho ki dhalaan (slope) kis taraf neeche ja rahi hai, aur chhota kadam us taraf lete ho. Ye baar-baar karte ho.

Model mein:
- "Pahaad" = loss (error)
- "Dhalaan" = gradient
- "Kadam ka size" = learning rate

Har step mein model apne weights thode badalta hai taaki error kam ho, aur aakhir mein minimum error ke paas pahunch jaata hai.

Kuch achhe plan, aapke location ke hisaab se:

1. Nature trip: paas ke hill station ya jungle par ek din ki drive. Sunrise trek ke saath chai ka maza alag hi hai.
2. Heritage walk: kisi purane kile, mandir ya museum ki sair, saath mein local street food.
3. Lake ya river side picnic: khana, music aur board games le jaayein.
4. Relaxed option: nayi cafe try karo aur phir movie dekho.

Aap batayein ki kis shehar mein ho, budget kitna hai aur kitne log hain, to main ek detailed plan bana dunga.

Weekend ki special ga Tomato Pulao try cheyyandi, chaala easy.

Kavalsinavi: 1 cup basmati biyyam, 2 tomatoes, 1 onion, pachimirchi 2, allam-velulli paste, pudina, nune/nepyi, pulao masala, uppu.

Vidhanam:
1. Biyyam 15 nimishalu nanapetti vadakattandi.
2. Kukker lo nune vedi chesi onion, pachimirchi, allam-velulli paste vesi vegindi.
3. Tomato mukkalu, masala, uppu vesi mediyam ga vundela cheyyandi.
4. Biyyam, 1.5 cups neellu posi 2 whistles vachey varaku ubikinchandi.

Raita tho serve cheste super untundi!

Gradient descent ante machine learning model tana tappulanu thagginchukune oka paddhati.

Oka konda meeda kallu mooskoni nilabadi, lopali lotha ku cheralani anukondi. Meeru kaalitho slope ye vaipu thaggutundo chusi, aa vaipu chinna adugu vestaru. Idi malli malli chestaru.

Model lo:
- "Konda" = loss (error)
- "Slope" = gradient
- "Adugu size" = learning rate

Pratee step lo model tana weights ni konchem marchi, error thagginchi, chivariki thakkuva error unde chota cheruthundi.

3. Lake/river side picnic: bhojanam, music, board games theesukelli enjoy cheyyandi.

Meeru e city lo unnaru, budget entha, entha mandi vastunnaru cheptey, nenu detailed plan isthanu.
